name: inference-benchmarker
description: A Hugging Face-hosted suite for measuring model inference performance across models and hardware. It focuses on system-level metrics such as latency, throughput, memory usage and related operational characteristics for different model architectures, batch sizes and device types.
evaluation_method: measured latency and throughput (system performance metrics)
reputation: Used by practitioners and engineers for practical inference benchmarking; modest academic citation but useful in engineering contexts.
